title: Finding Ledger and Runtime Evidence Integrity
description: Implement Section 9.3 of the accepted Dynamic Finding execution plan. Deliver Story 3A fenced exactly-once Finding ledger writes and Story 3B signed runtime-evidence freshness as the first dependency in the implementation sequence. RED must first reproduce historical duplicate IDs, lost updates, replay divergence, crash or torn-write exposure, and stale or environment-mismatched runtime evidence; GREEN must prove the committed contracts, migrations, adversarial cases, and gate behavior.
